name: Deathguard Humbert
summary: At Tarren Mill, Deathguard Humbert watches the Alliance presence in Hillsbrad. The Forsaken sentry has lost his military gear to dwarves from Dun Garok.

sections.title: A Guard Relieved of His Steel
sections.body: Deathguard Humbert watches Dun Garok from a hidden camp for High Executor Darthalia. One morning, he left to gather firewood. Dwarven scouts from Dun Garok took his prized sword and other equipment while he was away. Now he must recover his arms and save his pride before high command learns what happened.

faq.answer: Deathguard Humbert guards and scouts from Tarren Mill. He watches Alliance operations across the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What happened to Humbert's sword and armor?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia sent Humbert to watch Dun Garok from a hidden camp. One morning, he went to gather firewood. When he returned, dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had taken his gear, including his prized sword.

faq.q: Why doesn't Humbert just recover his gear himself?
faq.answer: Dun Garok is heavily fortified, with disciplined dwarven riflemen and mountaineers. A lone scout outside its trenches has little chance, and Humbert cannot easily leave his post without answering for how he lost his kit.

angles.text: Recovering Humbert's sword strikes back at the dwarven foothold in Hillsbrad and helps preserve the dignity of Tarren Mill's garrison.
Forsaken soldiers are expected to serve the Dark Lady with unyielding vigilance. Humbert's lapse against the living leaves an embarrassing blemish on the Deathguard.
